data.one_liner: CLI tool that generates type-safe Dart and Flutter classes from your Supabase database schema.
data.what_it_does: Supadart connects to your Supabase schema via a CLI command and generates immutable Dart classes, JSON serialisation, converters, enums, and insertion/update helpers tailored to your database tables and columns.
use_when: You want type-safe queries and inserts with Supabase in a Dart or Flutter project
You want to eliminate manual model writing for your Supabase tables
avoid_when: You prefer writing your database models and JSON serializers manually
You are not using Supabase as your backend
strengths: Eliminates boilerplate when mapping database schemas to Dart models
Generates type-safe insert and update helper methods
Supports multiple schemas and custom database enums
weaknesses: Requires running a CLI command whenever your database schema changes
Requires using a secret/service role key to fetch the schema from hosted Supabase projects
data.setup_notes: Activate via 'dart pub global activate supadart' and run supadart or configure a supadart.yaml file with your Supabase URL and key.
